mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the heart’s own vessels was most worthwhile: it showed why blood in the chambers alone cannot supply the thick heart muscle.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding blood was a predictable final assembly step, although its result usefully summarized the two routes.

surprise.text: I expected the heart’s own vessels to fit earlier; the compatibility feedback instead connected the pulmonary route first.

arbitrary.text: The required order for adding the heart’s own vessels was not clear from the available descriptions, though the later result explained their connection to the circulation.

continue.text: I would continue: the constructions connect structures to their jobs, and I would be curious to see how the circulation supports the responsive arm.
